name: visual-style-dna-replicator
title_zh: 参考图拆成可调参数，新主体照着复现的视觉基因提取器
tagline_zh: 设计师最怕“感觉不对”四个字。它把配色、构图、光影拆成数值，换主体、换产品、换文案都能保持同一套视觉基因。
tagline_en: Stop guessing 'feel'. It turns colors, layout, and lighting into numbers, so new subjects keep the same visual.
desc_en: Use when reference images must be analyzed, classified, converted into controllable visual parameters, or reproduced consistently with new subjects, products, characters, copy, or layouts.
why_zh: 不是滤镜套用，而是把风格拆成可复用的参数层，改主体时只动内容、不动基因，复现一致性远超手工调参。
why_en: Not a filter—it decomposes style into reusable parameter layers, so swapping subjects keeps the DNA intact, beating manual tweaks.
limit_zh: 只认静态参考图，不处理视频或动效；输出是参数与复现建议，不直接生成成品图；需配合图像生成工具使用。
limit_en: Static images only; no video/motion. Outputs parameters & guidance, not final renders. Requires an image generator; abstract art styles parse poorly.
title_en: Visual DNA Extractor: Turn Reference Images into.
